name: YQ-400 Monitor droid patrol ship
description: A product of the jointly funded design team of the Loronar Corporation and Corellian Engineering Corporation known as The Nerfworks, the YQ-400 Monitor Droid Patrol Ship was a small (36 meters long) ship designed to work in areas where high docking fees and trade tariffs provided most of a system's profits. Its primary job was to detect, locate and follow ships entering the system, although the lack of hyperdrive limited the ship to local areas only.
